title: Third-party Integrations
seo: Third-party app integration for your business
meta: Connect your product to payments, email, CRM and other tools you already pay for, tested end to end. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Connect your app to the tools you already use
overview: We connect your product to the outside services your business relies on, such as a payment provider, an email platform, a CRM or a shipping tool. You pick the tools and what should happen between them. We read the official developer docs, build the connection inside your accounts, handle errors and retries, and test with real sample data before we hand it over with notes.

pkgs.blurb: One tool connected with the key actions working.

pkgs.blurb: Two tools connected with retries and error alerts.
Up to four tools working together as one flow.

faq: Any tool with a public API or webhooks, including Stripe, PayPal, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Slack and shipping carriers. If a tool has no API, we say so before you pay.
Do I need paid accounts on those tools?
Yes, you keep your own accounts and plans, and the tools bill you directly. We only need developer or API access inside them, which we guide you to create.
Will this break when a tool changes?
Providers update their APIs from time to time. We build against current versions and note what to watch. Ongoing fixes are quoted separately under Integration Support.
No. We ask you to create API keys or add us as a collaborator, and we follow each tool's own rules. Keys are stored in environment settings, never in the code.
